request.spec: Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.
request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
The full suite passes: **258 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

The change requires rejecting a new owner (409 Conflict) when an existing owner already shares the **same last name and telephone number**.

Most of the infrastructure was already present in the repository from an earlier checkpoint (`DuplicateOwnerException`, its 409 handler in `ExceptionControllerAdvice`, and a duplicate-check hook in `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`). The prior logic, however, only rejected a full-field match (first name + last name + address + city + telephone). I narrowed the rule to match the new spec:

- **`ClinicServiceImpl.isSameOwner`** — now compares only last name and telephone. The surrounding `hasIdenticalOwner` already fetches candidates via `ownerRepository.findByLastName(...)`, so only new owners are checked and the 409 is raised through the existing exception path.
- **`DuplicateOwnerException`** — updated the Javadoc and message to reflect the last-name + telephone rule.

This satisfies both acceptance checkpoints: `Cp02Tests` (same last name + telephone → 409; same last name, different telephone → 2xx) and the pre-existing `Cp01Tests` (byte-identical owner still rejected, since it shares last name + telephone).
